verdict.rationale: LobeChat documents a guided onboarding that asks about your work and suggests starter Tasks, a single wizard for connecting a local Agent, and a 'one sentence to start' flow that sets up agent names, roles and behaviors. None of this is shown to cover model API credentials, messenger channels or instance defaults, and self-hosting is documented through Docker Compose deployment rather than a setup wizard. Missing for 10: a first-run wizard for model provider credentials, guided setup of channels (Telegram/Slack/Discord), configuration of defaults without editing env/config files, and hands-on corroboration.
